title: An empty Categories list still shows Name as sortable with an up arrow
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin of organization {Organization-A} (for example a newly created test organization) at its location {Location-A}, with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Organization-A} has no categories at all.
  • You are on a page other than Categories.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  3. Look at the Name column header.
  4. Click the Name column header.
  5. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  6. Look at the Name column header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the Name column header shows an arrow pointing up.
  • Step 6: the Name header still responds as a sortable column: its arrow now points down.
  • Steps 1 to 6: if no organization without categories can be reached (the Default category may always exist), this case cannot be checked by hand. Write 'not checked by hand: no organization without categories' in the result comment.
